verdict.rationale: Foreloop supports agents that poll for approved tasks on a cadence and work autonomously once approved, opening PRs without further intervention (foreloop-docs-37, foreloop-docs-3), and CLI can be invoked from cron (foreloop-docs-16). However, autonomy is gated: a human must approve each task contract before any work starts (foreloop-docs-7), and the agent runs on the user's own machine rather than as a fully hosted background service. Missing for 10: evidence of a hosted/managed always-on execution environment, and fully unattended operation without a human approval gate.
